sectors.name: Mining & Energy
themes: US steel and copper demand, driven by infrastructure spending and reshoring, will keep lifting NUE, STLD, and FCX, creating a durable bid for global metal prices that Indonesian exporters can ride.
Indonesia's downstream nickel and coal sectors face structural pressure from oversupply and weak Chinese offtake, making only cost-competitive, export-oriented producers viable long-term.
The IDR's persistent depreciation against the USD structurally favors Indonesian miners with dollar revenues and local costs, widening margins independent of commodity price swings.
sectors.ai: Buy selective Indonesian coal and nickel names on the US metals rally spillover, but avoid chasing SQMI/ALKA momentum as domestic demand remains soft. Favor FCX-linked copper exposure and NUE/STLD steel proxies for US infrastructure pull; hedge IDR weakness by rotating into dollar-earning miners. Trim losers before the next Fed-driven risk-off leg.

sectors.name: Renewables & Climate-Tech
themes: US clean-tech equities are decoupling from Indonesia's renewables lag due to AI data-center electricity demand and IRA-linked manufacturing credits, making US names the primary alpha source.
Indonesia's renewables upside hinges on JETP disbursement and captive industrial solar (GGRP) rather than grid-scale projects, keeping local names idiosyncratic and policy-dependent.
Energy storage and grid infrastructure are the durable structural winners as intermittent capacity scales, favoring integrated players (VST, CEG) with firm PPAs over pure-play equipment makers.
sectors.ai: Buy pullbacks in US-listed solar/energy-storage names (RUN, ARRY, SEDG) as rate-cut momentum and AI-driven power demand re-rate the sector; Indonesia exposure stays muted—focus on GGRP/ESSA only for domestic policy catalysts, not global beta. Rotate out of laggards into VST/CEG for contracted cash flows.

sectors.name: Consumer & FMCG

Foreign and domestic liquidity rotation into small-cap consumer names (BTEK, FLMC, KAQI) reflects risk-on appetite for high-beta stories, but sustainability hinges on earnings delivery next quarter.
sectors.ai: Buy selective small/mid-cap consumer names with confirmed volume breakouts (BWPT, SSMS, GZCO) and pair with liquid large-cap staples for downside protection. Momentum is broad but not euphoric—add on dips, avoid chasing +20% spikes without follow-through. Rotate into palm-oil-linked FMCG (BWPT) and regional snack/dairy plays (SSMS, GZCO) as rupiah stability supports input costs.
